question: Which team won the 2025 NBA championship, and who was the Finals MVP?
text:
**The Oklahoma City Thunder won the 2025 NBA championship, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was Finals MVP.**

The Thunder beat the Indiana Pacers in seven games.[1] They won Game 7 by 103–91 at Paycom Center.[2] It was the franchise's first NBA title since 1979, when it was still the Seattle SuperSonics.[3]

Gilgeous-Alexander, who was also the regular-season MVP, averaged 30.3 points, 4.6 rebounds and 5.6 assists in the series.[2] He was the first Canadian to win the Finals MVP award.[1]
